input.quote: CONTRACTOR'S MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO COMPANY ARISING FOR ANY REASON RELATING TO CONTRACTOR'S PERFORMANCE OF SERVICES UNDER A STATEMENT OF WORK SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR FOR THE PERFORMANCE OF SUCH SERVICES.
input.rationale: The cap is measured by fees paid under the individual Statement of Work (potentially a very small amount), not 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000, and the only carve-out is a broken cross-reference to "Paragraph 9", which is the Independent Contractor clause. There are no carve-outs for confidentiality, data/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud or IP infringement, and our payment obligations are not excluded from the cap. Mutual exclusion of consequential damages in 7(b) is acceptable.

input.quote: 7. LIMITATIONS OF LIABILITY; INDEMNIFICATION OF CONTRACTOR.
input.rationale: Despite the heading, Section 7 contains no indemnity language at all — no Contractor indemnity for third-party IP claims, breach of law, data incidents or misconduct (the non-infringement representation in 5(c) is a warranty, not a defence obligation). We inserted the standard Contractor indemnity at 7(d) with notice/control/cooperation mechanics and a narrow reverse indemnity from us.
